case_title: ELISE RAVEL VS. LAURIE VAN LOBEN SELS

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-08-2012 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RAVEL, ELISE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT VAN LOBEN SELS, LAURIE PLAINTIFF FAILED TO PROVE BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT'S CONTRACTOR DAMAGED THE TREES. DEFENDANT'S PHOTO FROM 2-11 SHOWS THE SAME DAMAGE TO TREES BEFORE CONSTRUCTION COMMENCED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAY-01-2012 ORDERED DESTROYED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,145.00 FILED BY RAVEL, ELISE AS TO DEFENDANT VAN LOBEN SELS, LAURIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-08-2012 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $0.) SERVED JAN-10-2012, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT VAN LOBEN SELS, LAURIE
